llm.model_note: the provider echoes the exact model snapshot that ran (recorded per call as model_returned)
llm.temperature_note: not set: requests carry no sampling parameter, so repeats are independent samples and no seed is supported

production_llm_path.statement: The production chat has an AI analytics path (question -> model classification + deterministic extraction -> validated structured request -> deterministic query engine -> verified result -> validated explanation); it needs OPENAI_API_KEY. Without one the legacy router answers.

system_labels.decisiongpt: DecisionGPT production chat, AI analytics path (the OpenAI model classifies the question into closed labels; deterministic code extracts periods/products/limits -> validated structured request -> deterministic query engine -> verified result -> templated answer); any answer served by the legacy fixed-intent router is flagged path=legacy_router and is NOT an AI answer - Target B (OpenAI)
system_labels.llm_code_baseline: Reference tool-use system: a model writing pandas code; NOT executed by this harness (not implemented for the OpenAI provider); retained for the record (NOT a simpler baseline, NOT DecisionGPT)

view.rules: 1) keep lines whose quantity is a whole number > 0 (sales.quantity is an integer column); 2) keep lines whose recomputed amount (qty*rate) agrees with a printed amount column; 3) merge lines that share (date, product, unit price) by summing quantity (the production upload validator rejects duplicate rows; merging preserves total sales and total units exactly; when a merged group mixed GST slabs, the slab with the largest revenue in the group is kept). Consequence: 'one row' no longer means 'one bill line', so no task asks about individual sale entries.

dataset_disclosure.description: Indian POS retail register, 1 Jan-31 Mar 2025
dataset_disclosure.provenance_limitation: Appears to be real Indian POS data from its structure and content; uploader/store provenance is NOT independently verified.
dataset_disclosure.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (as recorded in the repository)
dataset_disclosure.representativeness: NOT representative of Indian SMEs or Indian retail generally.

repeat_design.task_loop: for task: for repeat (same frozen tasks every repeat)

record.status: PROPOSED - NOT EXECUTED. No OpenAI request has been made for this smoke run; OPENAI_API_KEY was not configured when it was written.
record.purpose: Bounded smoke evaluation of the new provider on the frozen benchmark: confirm the live path works on each task family before any larger run.
record.selection_rule: For each of the six frozen task categories, the first task in frozen spec order (the same rule used for the earlier pilot). Applied to task metadata only.
record.planned_requests: 6 classification + up to 6 explanation requests = up to 12 (one bounded retry per request is possible on rate-limit / connection errors)

budget_basis.token_measurement: none yet for this provider; the first run's provider-reported usage replaces any estimate

not_proposed: pooling with the earlier Jev runs
record.interpretation_limits: n=5 scored tasks, one repeat: shows whether the path works per task family; not an accuracy estimate and no comparison with any other provider.

note: PARTIAL / PILOT EVALUATION: 6 of 27 frozen tasks x 1 repeat(s) (frozen protocol: 5). Frozen spec, ground truth, scorer and tolerances are unchanged. Not the full benchmark; small-sample figures are indicative only.

ground_truth_isolation.guard: whitelist check of every interpreter request + ground-truth fragment scan; a violating request is never sent and aborts the run

model_identity.seed_note: no sampling parameter or seed is set; repeats are independent requests
model_identity.retry_policy: bounded: at most 1 retry, only for rate-limit / connection errors that cannot have been processed; a timeout or server error is never re-sent, so an ambiguous failure cannot spend more; per-request timeout from OPENAI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; attempt counts are recorded per call
